operations.search:
version:
        description: Unsigned preview version (leave empty for a unique run version)
        required: false
        type: string
operations.replace:
version:
        description: Unsigned preview version (leave empty for a unique run version)
        required: false
        type: string
      windows_target:
        description: Windows delivery format (ZIP supports side-by-side validation)
        required: true
        default: nsis
        type: choice
        options:
          - nsis
          - zip

operations.search:
- name: Build isolated unsigned Windows installer
        run: |
          node scripts/build-desktop-artifact.ts --platform win --arch x64 --target nsis --fork-preview --build-version $env:PREVIEW_VERSION --wsl-runtime "C:\t3\wsl\t3-$env:PREVIEW_VERSION-linux-x64.tar.gz" --output-dir C:\t3\release --keep-stage --verbose
operations.replace:
- name: Build isolated unsigned Windows preview
        run: |
          if ($env:WINDOWS_TARGET -notin @('nsis', 'zip')) { throw 'Unsupported Windows preview target' }
          node scripts/build-desktop-artifact.ts --platform win --arch x64 --target $env:WINDOWS_TARGET --fork-preview --build-version $env:PREVIEW_VERSION --wsl-runtime "C:\t3\wsl\t3-$env:PREVIEW_VERSION-linux-x64.tar.gz" --output-dir C:\t3\release --keep-stage --verbose
- name: Upload Windows preview and provenance
